neurolang-query -i --engine neurosynth --resolution 2

NeuroLang's interactive query REPL, running entirely in your browser (Python on Pyodide). The first visit downloads about 100 MB, which your browser keeps. Queries that need gigabytes of memory, such as the whole of the uniformity-test tutorial, may not fit; type .help for the commands.
